item.title: Muthoot Finance Q2 cons profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 3,278 crore
item.description: Muthoot Finance reported a 36% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 3,278 crore in Q2, while assets under management grew 42% to Rs 2.09 lakh crore. However, standalone gross NPA ratio rose to 3.87% from 2.28% in the previous quarter, indicating a deterioration in asset quality

item.title: Sebi to release FII compliance consultation paper within weeks, says chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey
item.description: Sebi is likely to release a consultation paper on foreign investor compliance requirements within weeks, chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said. The proposed document will explore aligning Indian norms with global standards amid heavy FII outflows. The regulator is also planning a capacity-building network to strengthen independent directors’ effectiveness.

item.title: NTPC Q2 Results: Standalone profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 5,320 crore; revenue up 17%
item.description: NTPC has showcased a strong performance in the second quarter of FY27, with a significant 14% increase in standalone net profit year-on-year. The operational revenue saw a notable rise of 16.8% from the same quarter last year, reflecting solid financial health. An interim dividend of Rs 3 per share was announced for shareholders. In a move to bolster growth, NTPC is also increasing its capital expenditure on pumped storage initiatives.

item.title: Dalal Street Weak Ahead: Nifty stands on firmer footing, but can it break past 23,450?
item.description: The Nifty gained 2% last week, recovering above the crucial 200-week moving average at 22,700. While easing volatility and buying at lower levels support the rebound, bearish momentum indicators suggest caution. Analysts identify 23,300–23,450 as immediate resistance and 22,750–22,525 as key support for the coming week.

item.title: CDSL Q2 results: Net profit jumps 24% YoY to Rs 173 crore, revenue up 24%
item.description: CDSL reported a 24% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 173 crore, while revenue grew 23.7% to Rs 395 crore. EBITDA margin expanded to 58%. The depository opened around 75 lakh new demat accounts during the quarter, taking assets under custody beyond Rs 89 lakh crore.

item.title: ET Wealth Expo | Only 6 of 1990's Sensex stocks survive: S Naren's case for smarter asset allocation
item.description: S Naren of ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund highlights how only six companies from the 1990 Sensex remain in the benchmark today. At ET Wealth Expo, he explained why beaten-down stocks may never recover and urged investors to distinguish between asset allocation and stock selection, while cautioning against chasing strong past returns.

item.title: Turnaround Story: 8 stocks shift from loss to profit in September '26 quarter
item.description: Eight Nifty 500 stocks, including IndusInd Bank, Tata Motors and Delhivery, moved from losses to profits in the September 2026 quarter, according to StockEdge's profitability scan.

item.title: Sebi pushes for resilient capital markets, focuses on investor protection: Chairman
item.description: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey emphasized the importance of accessible and efficient capital markets at a recent forum. He highlighted the growth in market capitalisation with significant annual fundraising through equity and debt. The number of investors in West Bengal has dramatically increased, indicating regional market participation. Additionally, various steps have been taken to streamline compliance and fundraising processes for issuers.

item.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks that gain for 5 days in a row
item.description: Eight BSE 500 stocks gained in each of the five sessions between October 26 and 30, delivering cumulative returns of 10% to 21%.

item.title: ET Wealth Expo: Why market veteran S Naren thinks investors are getting gold, silver and asset allocation all wrong
item.description: ICICI Prudential MF's S Naren warns investors against chasing assets after spectacular rallies, highlighting how silver's 216% surge drew record ETF inflows before a 27% correction. At the ET Wealth Expo, he explained why genuine asset allocation means buying unpopular assets and why gold still deserves a place in portfolios.

item.title: Diwali stock picks: SBI Securities lists 11 stocks with up to 22% upside potential. Do you own any?
item.description: SBI Securities has picked 11 stocks for Samvat 2083, with up to 22% upside potential. The list spans steel, hospitality, jewellery, electronics and infrastructure.

item.title: LIC Housing Fin Q2 net profit grows 12% YoY
item.description: LIC Housing Finance experienced a 12% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit, reaching ₹1,507 crore. Total income for the quarter rose by 1.5% compared to the previous year. A notable improvement in asset quality contributed to the positive financial outcome and led to the reversal of impairment charges. Gross non-performing assets decreased significantly, highlighting better loan performance during the quarter.

item.title: New India slips into red with 1,267 cr loss in Q2
item.description: New India Assurance Company has revealed a concerning net loss of ₹1,267 crore for the September quarter, sharply contrasting with last year's profit of ₹63 crore. The sharp downturn is attributed to underwriting losses in key segments such as property, motor, and health insurance. Despite this, gross written premiums showed a modest increase of 5.14% year-on-year, totaling ₹11,083 crore.

item.title: Bank of Baroda's Q2 profit surges 36% YoY on NSE stake sale
item.description: In a remarkable financial performance, Bank of Baroda reported a staggering 36% rise in net profit for the second quarter, reaching ₹6,532 crore. This surge was propelled by significant non-interest income, recoveries from previously written-off accounts, and gains from the partial sale of its stake in the National Stock Exchange.

item.title: Reliance Retail Q2 profit takes a hit on Qcomm push
item.description: Reliance Retail Ventures reported a significant drop in net profit, down 24.5% year-on-year to ₹2,619 crore in the last quarter. Despite this, revenue improved by 5.8% to ₹80,220 crore, largely driven by a surge in grocery sales. The company's profitability was affected by strategic investments and evolving festive season patterns, alongside rising finance costs stemming from increased borrowing and interest rates. Focus remains on improving transactions and business model adaptation.

item.title: Jio Platforms profit zooms 14% on healthy user mix, digital play
item.description: Jio Platforms has unveiled an impressive 14% net profit growth to ₹8,387 crore for the September quarter, achieving a milestone subscriber count of 542 million, which includes 300 million utilizing 5G services. Revenue from operations climbed to ₹40,475 crore, fueled by a surge in digital services and a boost in average revenue per user, now at ₹218.8.

item.title: Airtel Africa Q2 profit rises 16% to $254 million
item.description: Airtel Africa has revealed a remarkable 15.9% jump in its quarterly net profit, reaching $254 million, fueled by robust revenue growth. The total revenue escalated to $1.97 billion, showcasing a 25.7% rise in reported currency. Operating profit surged by 28.5% to $659 million, while customer numbers soared by 11.6%, pointing to the growing demand for data and mobile money services. The company achieved a record underlying Ebitda margin of 50.

item.title: Indian Oil net profit triples YoY to 21,630 cr in Q2
item.description: Indian Oil experienced a remarkable surge in its net profit, which soared to ₹21,630 crore for the second quarter. This growth can be attributed to elevated pump prices and government subsidies for LPG sales. In contrast, the same quarter last year showcased a profit of only ₹7,610 crore. Moreover, operational revenue increased by 29%, reaching ₹2,62,935 crore, with the firm's operating profit from petroleum product sales more than doubling.

item.title: GAIL Q2 profit surges over two fold YoY to 4,650 cr despite global disruptions
item.description: GAIL (India) has reported a remarkable increase in net profit, reaching ₹4,650 crore for the September quarter, more than double from the previous year. This growth is attributed to heightened gas marketing margins amid global energy supply disruptions. Revenue also surged by 31% to ₹45,924 crore. Furthermore, GAIL has moved forward with plans to list its subsidiary GAIL Gas, enhancing its stock value by 1.7% to ₹168 per share.

item.title: ZEE profit sinks 40% YoY in Q2, but revenue rises on FIFA subscription growth
item.description: Zee Entertainment Enterprises faced a sharp drop in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, despite a 13% rise in operating revenue to ₹2,225 crore, spurred by FIFA World Cup-related subscriptions. Total costs surged by 18%, largely due to inflated programming and promotional expenses. In a bright spot, ZEE5's revenue surged over twofold, showcasing a successful digital approach.

item.title: Lodha Developers profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 1,013 crore in Sept quarter
item.description: Lodha has announced a remarkable 63% surge in net profit, reaching ₹2,386 crore for the first half of FY27. This growth is driven by impressive operational performance, with net profit for the September quarter rising by 28% to ₹1,013 crore and revenue climbing 18% to ₹4,468 crore. The company’s pre-sales also saw a 10% increase to ₹5,037 crore, alongside plans for expansion in NCR and Bengaluru.

item.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit takes a hit on exceptional items
item.description: Sun Pharmaceutical has seen a notable 36% drop in net profit, juxtaposed with an 11.8% rise in consolidated revenue. The uplift in revenue can be attributed largely to strong sales growth in India and emerging markets, particularly in domestic formulations. Conversely, US formulation sales faced a significant downturn. The company also marked progress in its integration planning for the acquisition of Organon, following the successful completion of regulatory approvals.

item.title: Varun Beverages Q3 net profit rises 13% YoY, but margins fall
item.description: Varun Beverages recorded a substantial net profit increase of 13.5% for the quarter ending September 2026. Although there was strong revenue growth attributed to both local and international sales, the company's shares dropped because of shrinking operating margins. Challenges arose from heightened packaging costs and sugar price surges affecting gross margins. Additionally, Varun Beverages solidified its partnership with PepsiCo, extending their licensing agreement through 2049.

item.title: Oil-to-chemicals business powers Reliance Industries' record quarterly net profit, up 34% to ₹29,550 crore
item.description: Reliance Industries Ltd has set a new benchmark with a record net profit of ₹29,550 crore for the September quarter, fueled by significant advancements in the oil-to-chemicals and digital segments. With a yearly revenue surge of 28.5% to ₹3.38 lakh crore, the O2C division's Ebitda skyrocketed 68%, reflecting the advantages of elevated energy prices and the firm’s adaptability in challenging market scenarios.

item.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
item.description: Sun Pharma reported a 36% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 1,989 crore due to exceptional litigation and acquisition-related costs. Revenue grew 11.8%, supported by strong domestic and emerging market sales, while US formulations weakened.

item.title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore
item.description: Syrma SGS Technology reported an 87.2% increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 2026. Consolidated revenue increased by 73.2%, reaching a record high of Rs 1,999.5 crore. The company’s exports grew by 91% year-on-year, showcasing strong international demand. Investments are planned in collaboration with Kaga Electronics to enhance the domestic supply ecosystem.

item.title: Zee Entertainment Q2 profit drops 40% to Rs 46 crore as EBITDA margin contracts to 3.2%
item.description: Zee Entertainment Enterprises reported a 40% decline in consolidated net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Operating revenue increased by 13%, largely due to growth in subscription revenue supported by the FIFA World Cup 2026. Total expenditure rose by 18% primarily driven by increased programming and promotional costs. ZEE5, the company's streaming platform, showed significant growth by doubling its revenue year-on-year.

item.title: Lodha Developers H1FY27 net profit soars 63%, expects to beat full-year guidance
item.description: Lodha Developers reported a 63% rise in first-half FY27 profit to Rs 2,386 crore, driven by strong property sales and market expansion. The developer expects to exceed annual profit guidance while pursuing data centres to boost recurring income.

item.title: Spandana Sphoorty makes profit in Q2 against a loss year-ago
item.description: Spandana Sphoorty Financial reported consolidated Q2 profit of Rs 18 crore, reversing a Rs 249 crore year-ago loss. Assets under management grew 31% to Rs 5,364 crore, while improving asset quality reduced gross and net NPAs.

item.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 profit jumps 36% to Rs 6,532 crore on NSE stake sale
item.description: Bank of Baroda reported 36% year-on-year profit growth to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27, boosted by NSE stake sale gains and higher interest income. The lender raised annual credit and deposit growth guidance amid strong loan demand.

item.title: Record earnings! 5 big takeaways from RIL Q2 results investors should watch for Monday trading
item.description: Reliance Industries reported record Q2FY27 profit of Rs 29,550 crore and revenue of Rs 3.62 lakh crore, driven by strong refining margins and Jio growth. Retail profitability weakened, while declining debt improved the conglomerate's financial position.

item.title: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: Revenue up 6%, but late festive season, digital spends hit profit
item.description: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: The company's gross revenue increased 6.4% YoY to Rs 91,716 crore in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 86,169 crore in the year-ago period. The growth came despite the absence of major festive occasions during the quarter, with the festive calendar shifting to the December quarter.

item.title: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Profit shoots up 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore, revenue surges 29%
item.description: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Mukesh Ambani-led Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) on Friday reported a 41% year-on-year (YoY) growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore for the September quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 18,165 crore in the corresponding period last year.

item.title: Jio Platforms Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 8,389 crore; revenue up 11%
item.description: Jio Q2 Results: Jio Platforms reported a 14% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 8,389 crore in Q2 FY27, its first results after listing. Revenue grew 11% to Rs 40,475 crore, supported by subscriber additions, growth in digital services and a marginal increase in ARPU.

item.title: NTPC Green Energy Q2 Results: Profit jumps 56% YoY to Rs 137 crore, revenue rises 53%
item.description: NTPC Green Energy reported a 56.2% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 137.5 crore, driven by 53.2% revenue growth. EBITDA margins improved, while new solar capacity boosted its operational renewable energy portfolio.

item.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 6,532 crore; NII up 9%
item.description: Bank of Baroda reported a 35.8% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27. Net interest income grew 9% to Rs 13,026 crore, while asset quality improved, with the gross NPA ratio declining to 1.78%. Global advances and deposits also recorded double-digit growth.

item.title: Coforge among 6 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 20% in a month
item.description: Six BSE 200 stocks, including Coforge, Indian Hotels and Kotak Mahindra Bank, hit fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex rallied, with monthly gains reaching 17%.

item.title: 8 midcap stocks with over 100% profit growth in Q2FY27
item.description: Eight NSE midcap stocks recorded over 100% year-on-year profit growth in Q2FY27, led by Max Financial Services, One97 Communications and Poonawalla Fincorp, according to StockEdge data.

item.title: Aditya Birla Capital Q2 profit rises 38% to Rs 1,288-cr
item.description: Aditya Birla Capital reported an impressive 38% profit increase for the September quarter of FY27, with profit after tax soaring to Rs 1,288 crore, up from Rs 933.52 crore year-over-year. Operational revenues also climbed significantly, reaching Rs 14,003 crore. Lending assets under management witnessed a robust 32% growth to Rs 2.34 lakh crore, while shares gained 1.75% on the Bombay Stock Exchange.

item.title: Market wrap: Shriram Finance, Nestle India, Trent, InterGlobe top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
item.description: The Nifty 50 rose 0.51% to close at 23,053.10 on Friday, while the Sensex gained 308 points to 74,459.53. Trent and InterGlobe led the gainers, while Shriram Finance and Nestle India topped the Nifty losers. Broader markets remained weak, with midcap and smallcap indices falling up to 2%.

item.title: Sebi issues final order against Axis Capital, imposes regulatory censure; Axis Bank shares fall over 1%
item.description: SEBI has issued a regulatory censure against Axis Capital, concluding proceedings linked to September 2024 restrictions. The regulator noted no recorded investor harm or fraudulent default, while Axis Bank expects no material business impact.

item.title: Asian Paints’ consolidated profit jumps 7.5% YoY in Q2
item.description: Asian Paints reported a 7.5% year-on-year rise in Q2 consolidated profit to Rs 1,067.6 crore, while net sales grew 16.9% to Rs 9,953.9 crore. Higher raw material costs weighed on margins, prompting further staggered price hikes. The company also declared a dividend of Rs 5.75 per share.

item.title: Sensex rises 308 points, Nifty above 23,000 even as broader markets crash. Will D-Street bulls extend recovery next week?
item.description: Indian market indices Sensex and Nifty ended the week on a high note, each climbing by up to 0.5%. Even as the broader market suffered losses, standout performers like Trent and IndiGo flourished thanks to positive earnings. The Nifty IT index was a highlight, soaring over 2%, while Nifty Consumer Durables fell nearly 2%.

item.title: FIIs hold $717 billion worth of Indian stocks, but trim exposure across 56% of Nifty 500 companies. Where are they investing?
item.description: FIIs held $717 billion worth of Nifty 500 stocks in September 2026, with private banks accounting for the largest share of their investments. While foreign investors increased exposure to sectors such as healthcare, technology and automobiles, they trimmed holdings in 56% of Nifty 500 companies over the past year.

item.title: Sun Pharma Q2 Results: Profit falls 36% YoY to Rs 1,989 crore on exceptional charges
item.description: Sun Pharma Q2 Results: Revenue from operations rose 12% YoY to Rs 16,199 crore from Rs 14,478 crore in Q2 of last financial year, supported by strong growth in its domestic formulations business and emerging markets.

item.title: Varun Beverages shares fall over 4% as Q3 margin pressure weighs despite a 33% YoY revenue growth
item.description: Varun Beverages reported strong Q3 CY2026 revenue, profit and volume growth, but its shares fell as higher packaging costs weighed on margins. EBITDA margin declined 140 basis points year-on-year, while the company announced an interim dividend of Rs 0.50 per share.

item.title: Reliance Industries Q2 Results 2026 Live: RIL Q2 profit jumps 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore; co posts highest-ever quarterly revenue; Jio ARPU rises to Rs 218.8
Coal India shares fall 3% after Q2 results; Jefferies, Motilal Oswal, others cut target price
item.description: Coal India shares fell 3% despite a 57% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 6,547 crore. Jefferies and JM Financial cut their target prices to Rs 460 and Rs 438, respectively, while Motilal Oswal retained its Buy rating with a Rs 450 target, citing a potential volume recovery.

item.title: Explained: Why AI giants Google, Amazon, Intel shares crashed up to 23% in a single day
item.description: Shares of Alphabet, Amazon and Intel plunged on Thursday as investors fretted over rising AI spending, weakening cash flows and a subdued outlook. Alphabet shares fell over 13% after its Q3 results missed Wall Street estimates, with slowing search advertising growth and higher AI investments weighing on sentiment.

item.title: Equitas SFB shares tumble 27% in 2 days on CEO exit. More pain ahead?
item.description: Equitas Small Finance Bank shares plunged 27% in two sessions after CEO and founder PN Vasudevan announced his resignation over a perceived conflict involving his daughter’s NBFC.
